Match gauging stations to rating stations

Source: R/match_stations.R
match_stations.Rd

Links the stations in a gauging archive to the stations in an operational ratings export, so each rating can be checked against its own gaugings. The two files name stations differently, so the link is made in two ways, and you decide how much of each to use:

  • A table you supply (crosswalk): one row per link, with the rating's station id (FFFSLocID) and the matching gauging reference (the gauging file's station number). This is the reliable route, and it takes priority. A rating station can map to several references, and several rating stations to one.

  • The ids as they stand (direct = TRUE, the default): for a rating station that the table does not link to a gauging station, the station id is compared with the gauging file's station ids directly. Case and surrounding spaces are ignored; nothing else is altered, so 065006 does not match 065006_TG_802 unless the table says so.

Nothing is guessed. What does not match is reported, on both sides, so the table can be extended until the matches you expect are there.

Usage

match_stations(
  gaugings,
  ratings,
  crosswalk = NULL,
  crosswalk_station = "FFFSLocID",
  crosswalk_reference = "Reference",
  direct = TRUE,
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

gaugings

A data.table from read_gaugings(), or any table with a station_id column (and, optionally, station_name, observation_time).

ratings

A data.table from read_operational_ratings(), or any table with a station_id column (and, optionally, station_name and rating_key).

crosswalk

A data.frame with one column of rating station ids and one of gauging references, or NULL (default) to match on the ids alone.

crosswalk_station, crosswalk_reference

Character. Names of the two columns of crosswalk. Defaults "FFFSLocID" and "Reference". Names are matched ignoring case.

direct

Logical. Also match ids directly where the table gives no link. Default TRUE.

quiet

Logical. TRUE suppresses the summary message.

Value

A list of four data.tables.

  • links: one row per link, with station_id (the rating side), gauging_station_id and link ("crosswalk" or "direct").

  • unmatched_ratings: rating stations with no gauging station, with station_id, station_name, n_ratings and n_limbs.

  • unmatched_gaugings: gauging stations with no rating station, with station_id, station_name, n_gaugings and, when the gaugings have an observation_time, first_gauging and last_gauging.

  • crosswalk_unused: rows of crosswalk that could not be used, with the reason: the station is not in the ratings, the reference is not in the gaugings, or neither, or a value is missing.

See also

check_operational_ratings() to run the comparison for every matched rating.

Examples

gaugings <- data.frame(
  station_id = c("10250", "10250", "F2405", "684500007", "SD47651250"),
  station_name = c("BATHFORD", "BATHFORD", "Skelton", "WHITE MILL", "TAWD")
)
ratings <- data.frame(
  station_id = c("10250", "10250", "065006_TG_802", "684500007", "29004"),
  station_name = c("Bathford", "Bathford", "Pelic Seiont", "White Mill", "Ancholme"),
  rating_key = c("a/1", "a/1", "b/1", "c/1", "d/1")
)

# Without a table, only identical ids match
match_stations(gaugings, ratings)$unmatched_ratings
#> match_stations(): 2 of 4 rating stations matched (0 by table, 2 directly); 2 of 4 gauging stations matched.
#>   Unmatched: 2 rating stations, 2 gauging stations. Table rows not used: 0.
#>       station_id station_name n_ratings n_limbs
#>           <char>       <char>     <int>   <int>
#> 1: 065006_TG_802 Pelic Seiont         1       1
#> 2:         29004     Ancholme         1       1

# A table links what the ids alone cannot, and reports a row that fails
crosswalk <- data.frame(
  FFFSLocID = c("065006_TG_802", "29004", "99999"),
  Reference = c("F2405", "NOT_IN_GAUGINGS", "10250")
)
result <- match_stations(gaugings, ratings, crosswalk)
#> match_stations(): 3 of 4 rating stations matched (1 by table, 2 directly); 3 of 4 gauging stations matched.
#>   Unmatched: 1 rating stations, 1 gauging stations. Table rows not used: 2.
result$links
#>       station_id gauging_station_id      link
#>           <char>             <char>    <char>
#> 1: 065006_TG_802              F2405 crosswalk
#> 2:         10250              10250    direct
#> 3:     684500007          684500007    direct
result$crosswalk_unused
#>      row station       reference                    reason
#>    <int>  <char>          <char>                    <char>
#> 1:     2   29004 NOT_IN_GAUGINGS reference not in gaugings
#> 2:     3   99999           10250    station not in ratings
result$unmatched_gaugings
#>    station_id station_name n_gaugings
#>        <char>       <char>      <int>
#> 1: SD47651250         TAWD          1
